node.title: Re^3: PayPal IPN Script End of script output before headers:
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: These two warnings sound like perhaps you've accidentally used the + operator instead of the concatenation operator ., but as [marto] [id://11109307|said], you didn't actually show the code that's causing the error. As for why it's giving you a "500 Can't connect to ipnpb.sandbox.paypal.com:443", I'd suggest trying to connect to that URL using [man://curl] and writing a simple command-line script using [mod://LWP::UserAgent] to connect to that server, and debugging that.
